mapper.insert: INSERT INTO homework_submission (question_id, user_name, answer_content, answer_language, status) VALUES (#{questionId}, #{userName}, #{answerContent}, #{answerLanguage}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, q.question_title, q.course_name FROM homework_submission s LEFT JOIN homework_question q ON s.question_id = q.question_id WHERE s.submission_id = #{submissionId}
SELECT s.*, q.question_title, q.course_name FROM homework_submission s LEFT JOIN homework_question q ON s.question_id = q.question_id WHERE s.user_name = #{userName} ORDER BY s.submit_time DESC
SELECT s.*, q.question_title, q.course_name FROM homework_submission s LEFT JOIN homework_question q ON s.question_id = q.question_id WHERE s.question_id = #{questionId} ORDER BY s.submit_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE homework_submission SET status = #{status} WHERE submission_id = #{submissionId}
